property.item: Manifestación tipo A scope: single-family dwelling, or extension, up to this total built area
property.sourceTitle: Reglamento de Construcciones para el Distrito Federal, art. 51 I (última reforma G.O. 4 oct 2024)
property.publisher: Poder Judicial de la Ciudad de México (official transparency copy)
property.note: Two levels, max height 5.5 m, clear spans of 4 m or less, lot frontage of at least 6 m; must respect área libre and the PDU. Boundary walls (bardas) up to 2.50 m are also tipo A. A lot in a risk zone requires tipo B.

property.item: Art. 62 works needing no manifestación or licencia: demolition limit in a single-storey building
property.sourceTitle: Reglamento de Construcciones para el Distrito Federal, art. 62 VI
property.publisher: Poder Judicial de la Ciudad de México (official transparency copy)
property.note: Art. 62 has NO size-based exemption for sheds or garages. Exempt works are repairs of finishes, waterproofing, interior office divisions, urgent works, provisional site buildings during construction, gardening works, hoardings projecting less than 0.5 m onto the sidewalk, and similar non-structural works, with notice given via the Plataforma Digital. A new shed is therefore a tipo A manifestación.

property.item: Zonificación expression: use / max levels / minimum área libre % / density (example H/3/20/500)
property.sourceTitle: ¿Qué es la zonificación?
property.publisher: PAOT (Procuraduría Ambiental y del Ordenamiento Territorial de la CDMX)
property.note: The 20% is PAOT's worked example, not a citywide rule. Área libre is set per lot by each alcaldía's Programa (Delegacional/Parcial) de Desarrollo Urbano. The general rules set no fixed front or side setbacks.
